items.evidence: roll.py --headless --board 3 with my own script (right/left to coin -2, ride bridge from tick 380, right off at 530): tick 604 board 3 score 20; tick 606 board 4, screen play, ball (-2.9992,1.248,0) just after spawn at (-3,1.25,0), coins (-2,0.25,0),(2.2,1.2,0),(3.5,0.25,1.5). --board 4 accepted (tick 1: ball (-3,1.248,0)). Frame shows one slab and the ramp.

Board 4, 0:right held: y 0.5166 at x -0.287 (tick 71); CLI --ticks 92 gives ball (1.075, 0.981); y stays above 0.6 to x 2.57. Ramp solid: ball pushed -z into the ramp side at x -0.22 stops at z 1.25 and bounces back; ball pushed back left under the high end stops at x 1.07-1.15; on the slope it rides at top+0.265. Min distance from ball centre to the brief's ramp box over all runs 0.243-0.249 (radius 0.25), never through.

--board 4 --inputs "0:right,95:left,160:down,198:up,236:none": the air coin is taken at tick 102 with ball at (1.76, 1.01, 0), in flight past the ramp top; the last coin is taken at tick 203; at tick 300: screen won, score 30, sounds end coin, clear. Chained from board 3 (--board 3): won with score 60; enter then returns to title.
--board 1..4 with en/es/fr settings folders: 'Board n of 4', 'Tablero n de 4', 'Plateau n sur 4' for n = 1-4. The frames show BOARD 4 OF 4 and PLATEAU 4 SUR 4.

Language menu_right steps en->es->fr->en, and menu_left from en gives fr. With fr: title [Roll, Jouer, Réglages, Quitter]; settings [Réglages, Volume: 8, Langue: Français, Balle: Normale/Légère/Lourde, Retour]; play/paused [Plateau 1 sur 4, Score : 0, Vies : 3, Pause, Reprendre, Retour au titre]; won [Vous avez gagné, Score : 30, Appuyez sur Entrée pour revenir au titre]; lost [Partie terminée, ...]; language fr. The frames show the accented capitals correctly.

Settings rows are Volume, Language, Ball, Back (menu_down x3 selects Back). Ball is Normal by default; right gives Heavy, left gives Light and it stops at the ends; ball_kind follows (light/normal/heavy). Names shown: es Bola: Normal, fr Balle: Légère/Normale/Lourde.

Board 2, settings light/normal/heavy, 0:right: the ball is at the same spot (-0.4875, 0.2833) at tick 67 for all three; crates first move at tick 68. Summed crate displacement 120 ticks after the strike, tracked per crate: light 2.82, normal 7.81, heavy 13.26 (also with 0:right,60:none: 1.55/2.51/5.91; 90:none: 2.36/4.71/11.45).

A folder set to vol 7, fr, light reloads as 7 fr light on the next run; heavy is kept with --board 2. The pre-change game (medium3d-plain-2, run with -B into my scratch) saved {volume 6, language es}; the changed game loads that as 6 es normal. With no settings folder: 8 en normal.

Re-ran the earlier items that passed: m01/m02 run, 800x480 PNGs; m03 four WAVs 0.15-0.9 s, peak 29490, four distinct md5s; m04/m05 focus, volume 0..10 clamp, Back->title; m06 Spanish on every screen; m07 kept; m08 first at y<=0.3 at tick ~26, rest 0.2488, 3 bounces; m09 all four directions and still moving 40 ticks after release; m10 board 1 cleared by a driven script -> board 2 at start with 3 coins, 6 crates, clear; m11 drift 0.0; m12 a crate fell off and the top one moved 0.37, ball at x=1 at tick 99 vs 85 empty, none sank; m13 removed at 209; m14 fall resets the ball and lives 2 carry to board 2; m15 1,2,1,0; m16 rides with constant offset -0.77, gap fall costs a life; m17 board 3 -> board 4 -> won; m18/m19 frozen; m20 identical; m21 frames; m23 volume 0 gives a silent WAV and gui skips playback; m24 README.

b4.png (--board 4 --ticks 60 --frame) is 800x480 and shows the green slab, the brown ramp as a slab with visible thickness rising toward +x, the shaded ball, and the coins; b4fly.png shows the ball in the air past the ramp top with its shadow below, plus the 2 coins not yet taken.

CHANGES.md lists the changes by file (game.py BOARDS[4], physics ramps, render, font accents, settings), how they were checked (headless runs, frames), and the bugs found before (text overflow, push carried over, coin height).

defects: README says ready-made WAVs are in sounds/, but work/sounds holds only bounce.wav and clear.wav (coin.wav and fall.wav are missing); --all-wavs regenerates all four.

A push held when a board is cleared stays held on the next board (the input stays set until changed). This was already the game's behaviour and is harmless, but the next board starts with the push applied.
The ball gives 'bounce' sounds when it reaches the foot of the ramp (noted by the builder).
